title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.31457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular,

translated_title: Taxi：以（真实）大规模分析智能体
translated_abstract: 在这份技术报告中，我们提出了 Taxi——一个用于大规模调试、聚类和监控智能体的系统。Taxi 能够高效地扩展到数百万个步骤，这得益于多种可扩展分析方法的组合。Taxi 主要依靠聚类来生成步骤的分类体系，从而对数据进行结构化概览，并为工程师和自动化智能体提供完整的 SQL 访问权限，以便提出复杂的问题。聚类和查询最好在编码智能体引导的混合流水线中结合使用。Taxi 还包含 Jev 式决策模型的实验性集成：这类模型将状态和有界问题直接映射为类型化的、概率性的决策。在嵌入或字面查询不足以解决问题时，它们提供了低成本的语义路由和评估。此外，Taxi 提供了一个可扩展的生态系统，包括内置的评估器和每日报告。为适应增长需求，Taxi 被设计为模块化的，
tldr: Taxi 是一个可高效扩展至数百万步骤的大规模智能体调试、聚类与监控系统，通过聚类分类体系、完整 SQL 查询和 Jev 式决策模型的混合流水线，为工程师和自动化智能体提供结构化分析能力。
en_tdlr: Taxi is a scalable system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents across millions of steps, combining clustering taxonomies, full SQL access, and experimental Jev-style decision models in a hybrid pipeline for structured analysis.
